title: Developer Experience initiative: Contributor feedback surface & iteration pipeline
creator: Samira Chen
description: Build a lightweight, repeatable pipeline to collect, surface, triage, and close the loop on contributor and developer feedback across SDKs, docs, and quickstarts. Goal: reduce time-to-fix for high-impact issues, increase signal-to-noise for PM/Eng prioritization, and tie outcomes to DevX OKRs for Q2. This ticket scopes the end-to-end flow, initial automation, and a 6-week iteration plan for the first pilot language SDK and docs hub.
acceptance_criteria: Feedback ingestion endpoint created (form + GitHub issue template + SDK telemetry hook) and documented
Triage board populated with automated labels and priority heuristics for first 30 days
One automated pipeline that converts high-confidence issues into draft PRs or JIRA/Linear tickets for eng/design
Dashboard tracking SLA from report -> fix (median time <= 14 days for P0/P1) for pilot scope
OKR mapping doc created linking feedback-driven improvements to DevX adoption and NPS targets
updates: 2026-02-22: Kickoff with Eng, Docs, and DX design. Aligned on pilot scope: JavaScript SDK + Quickstarts + docs website top-10 pages.
2026-02-27: Engineering feasibility review completed. Agreed to surface telemetry via a lightweight SDK hook and add a GitHub issue template for reproducible reports.
2026-03-03: Prototype triage board created in Linear. Initial label taxonomy proposed: area:sdks|docs, impact:{high,medium,low}, reproducibility:{yes,no}, priority:auto-assigned by heuristics.
2026-03-06: Design submitted wireframes for 'report an issue' modal in docs site. PM feedback requested modifications for GDPR consent text.
2026-03-09: First automation spike: webhook-based bot that tags issues with stack traces and repro snippets in PR body. POC succeeded on 3 sample reports; next step: scale parsing rules.
2026-03-10: Aligned with Growth on metrics to expose on dashboards (signal rate, median time-to-triage, conversion-to-fix). Next milestone: dashboard MVP by 2026-03-20.
rollout_plan: Week 1: Instrumentation + GitHub issue template rollout + triage board setup
Week 2-3: Automations for labeling and parsing; pilot with internal contributors
Week 4: Open feedback surface to early external contributors; collect first 50 signals
Week 5-6: Evaluate signals, ship first 3 fixes; measure SLA and update heuristics
Post-pilot: Expand to other language SDKs and docs pages; automate backlog prioritization into PM/ENG planning
impact_metrics: Signal conversion rate (report -> actionable ticket) target >= 35%
Median time report->fix for P0/P1 <= 14 days
DevX NPS change (pilot cohort) +5 points after three shipped improvements
